homage.zh_note: Classical has 敬禮 in all 21 stanzas; DharmaMitra has 頂禮. Both are standard. 敬禮 is what Chinese practitioners already chant, and a modern reader understands it.

tara.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft
tara.zh_note: Classical 救度母 / 尊聖救度母; DharmaMitra 度母 / 救度母; the Karmapa-office title uses 度母. The short name 度母 is the common modern one.

benefits.zh_source: standard Buddhist term + DharmaMitra zh draft
benefits.zh_note: Standard rendering of ཕན་ཡོན; classical has no heading for it.

noble_venerable.zh_source: standard Buddhist term + DharmaMitra zh draft
noble_venerable.zh_note: རྗེ་བཙུན་ = 至尊 (standard); འཕགས་མ = 聖. Classical opening has 尊聖救度母; DharmaMitra 至尊聖救度母. Used before 度母: 至尊聖度母.

sanskrit_title.en: Namaḥ Tārā Ekaviṃśati Stotra Guṇahita Sāka
sanskrit_title.zh: Namaḥ Tārā Ekaviṃśati Stotra Guṇahita Sāka
sanskrit_title.zh_note: The Sanskrit title line stays in IAST, as in English (zh register rule).

praise.zh_source: DharmaMitra zh draft + standard Buddhist term
praise.zh_note: Classical uses 讚 / 讚嘆 / 稱歎; DharmaMitra 讚頌. 讚頌 is the clearest modern word for བསྟོད་པ.

blessed_tara.zh_note: བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ; 世尊度母 is used in modern Tibetan-Buddhist Chinese. 薄伽梵母 would be the technical alternative (advanced grade).
blessed_tara.zh_decision: Claude pick — user delegated flagged picks ("go with your picks"), 2026-09-24

perfectly.zh_note: ཡང་དག / ཡང་དག་པར as a modifier; appears inside 圓滿具足 (1-15, 1-21). In a-1 it is part of 正等覺佛.

perfect_buddha.zh_note: ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས = samyaksaṃbuddha = 正等覺 (standard pair). DharmaMitra wrote 正等覺如來, adding 如來 which is not in the Tibetan.

blessed_one.zh_source: standard Buddhist term + DharmaMitra zh draft
blessed_one.zh_note: བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས(མ) = 世尊. Only occurs inside 世尊度母 (a-1).

actual_praise.zh_note: Section heading བསྟོད་པ་དངོས. DharmaMitra 正行讚頌 borrows 正行 ("main practice"), which fits a sādhana, not a section of a text. 讚頌正文 = "the praise itself".
actual_praise.zh_decision: Claude pick — user delegated flagged picks ("go with your picks"), 2026-09-24

lightning.zh_source: DharmaMitra zh draft + classical canon (CBETA T1108)
lightning.zh_note: Classical 電光; DharmaMitra 閃電光. 閃電 is the plain modern word.

world.zh_note: Classical 三世界 (1-1), 七世界 (1-5). DharmaMitra mixes 三界 / 七世間界. 三界 is avoided because in Chinese it names the desire/form/formless realms (ཁམས་གསུམ), a different Tibetan word.
world.zh_decision: Claude pick — user delegated flagged picks ("go with your picks"), 2026-09-24

face.zh_note: Classical 面 (single character, too short to lock in modern prose); DharmaMitra 面容 / 容顏. Also inside 蓮花面容 (1-8).

lotus.zh_source: DharmaMitra zh draft + classical canon (CBETA T1108)
lotus.zh_note: Classical 蓮華 is the same word in older spelling; 蓮花 is the modern form.

lotus_face.zh_note: 1-8 only (her own face, likened to a lotus), as settled in the English fact-check.

light.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft

blaze.zh_note: DharmaMitra 熾燃 / 熾然 (inconsistent — locked to 熾燃); classical 熾盛. 熾燃 keeps the sense of flames.

moon.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft
moon.zh_note: All sources use 月. Includes the kenning རི་དགས་རྟགས་ཅན ("deer-marked one") in 1-18, as in English.

peace.zh_source: DharmaMitra zh draft + standard Buddhist term
peace.zh_note: ཞི / ཞི་བ = 寂靜 (standard). Classical 靜 / 善靜 / 寂滅.

without_exception.zh_note: Classical 盡無餘 / 攝無餘; DharmaMitra 無餘. Readers know 一切無餘.

hum.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + modern Tārā-mantra recitation

trampling.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft
trampling.zh_note: Classical 足踏 / 踐蹋; DharmaMitra 足下踏. Single character so the verb can sit in natural phrases (踩踏, 踏於).

feet.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft

tuttare.zh_note: ཏུཏྟྭ་ར. The Tārā mantra is commonly recited 嗡 達咧 都達咧 都咧 梭哈. Classical writes it three ways (怛囉 1-5, 覩怛哩 1-10, 咄怛哩 1-20); DharmaMitra left Latin. Same normalisation as the English "tuttare".

hosts.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft

spirit.zh_note: འབྱུང་པོ (bhūta). Classical and DharmaMitra both write the transliteration 部多, which a general reader cannot parse. 鬼神 is the ordinary Chinese word for spirits and keeps it distinct from 邪魅 (གདོན).

destroy.zh_note: DharmaMitra 摧毀; classical 摧壞 / 摧滅 (same root 摧).

phat.zh_note: ཕཊ. 呸 is the common modern Chinese form in Tibetan-Buddhist mantras; classical writes 發. Chinese characters per the user's choice.

trat.zh_note: ཏྲད. Not part of the common mantra, so the classical form 特囉 (1-7 特囉胝發) is used.

ture.zh_note: ཏུ་རེ. Recitation form 都咧 (嗡 達咧 都達咧 都咧 梭哈); classical 都哩.

great.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft
great.zh_note: ཆེན་མོ / ཆེན་པོ (1-8 大怖畏, 1-15 大罪). 2-3 ཆེ་བ is split out as "greater" for Chinese.

supreme.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft
supreme.zh_note: རབ in 1-10 (supreme joy): classical 最極喜, DharmaMitra 極喜.

power.zh_note: དབང in 1-10 (brings māras and the world under her power). Classical 作攝伏; DharmaMitra 降伏 ("subdue by force"), which is stronger than the Tibetan. 攝伏 = bring under one's control.

joy.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft
joy.zh_note: Classical 歡悅 / 喜悅 / 喜笑; DharmaMitra 喜 / 歡喜 / 極喜. The shared character 喜 is locked so compounds stay natural.

syllable_hum.zh_note: Classical 吽字 / 吽聲; Chinese puts the syllable before 字.

ability.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft
ability.zh_note: ནུས ("able to"). Chinese says this with 能 (classical 亦能鉤召 1-11, 悉能鉤召 1-5). Added 1-5 for Chinese, where the same ནུས occurs; English did not lock it there.

perfectly_endowed.zh_note: ཡང་དག་ལྡན (1-15, 1-21). DharmaMitra 圓滿具足; classical 皆具足.

endowed.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft

mantra.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + standard Buddhist term
mantra.zh_note: སྔགས. Classical 呪 is a variant of 咒; DharmaMitra alternates 咒 / 真言 — locked to 咒 (根本咒 1-22, 十字咒 / 明咒 1-16).

goddess.zh_note: ལྷ་མོ (2-1). 天女 is the usual Chinese for lha mo / devī (cf. 吉祥天女). Kept distinct from 世尊 (བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མ), as in English.

vetala.zh_note: རོ་ལངས ("risen corpse"): classical 起屍 (1-6). DharmaMitra has 起屍 in 1-21 but 羅剎 (rākṣasa, a different being) in 1-6 — Phase 2 must correct 1-6.

empowerment.zh_source: classical canon (CBETA T1108) + DharmaMitra zh draft + standard Buddhist term
empowerment.zh_note: དབང in 2-3 (the Victors confer empowerment). Classical benefits section 灌頂.

demon.zh_note: གདོན (afflicting spirits). DharmaMitra 魔 / 鬼 — but 魔 is needed for བདུད (Māra) in 1-8 and 1-10. Classical 執魅 (1-21) points to 魅. 邪魅 = harmful spirits.

yaksha.zh_source: DharmaMitra zh draft + standard Buddhist term
yaksha.zh_note: གནོད་སྦྱིན. Classical 藥叉 is the older spelling of the same word.

might.zh_note: མཐུ (1-21): classical 善靜威力; DharmaMitra 威德力.

greater.zh_source: DharmaMitra zh draft + standard Buddhist term
greater.zh_note: Chinese-only split from "great": ཆེ་བ in 2-3 is comparative ("greater than this"), so 大 does not fit. DharmaMitra 更勝者.
